title: SfdcPartnerPackage - Data API
description: Represents a managed package owned by a partner in a Partner Business Org (PBO). This object is available in API version 64.0 and later.

Id.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort
Id.description: System field. The unique identifier for the record.

NamespacePrefix.description: The prefix of the namespace where this package lives.

Package.description: The external ID of the associated managed package.

PackageName.description: The public name of the associated package.
